main_text.p: no. Non negandum tamen, & alia admodum calida, ut vitrum combu-ftum, cantharides, calculum diffol-vere, abradendo eum, & in pulve-rem redigendo.

Quæ menses movent, propriè sunt medicamenta obstructiones uteri a-perientia, & abstergentia, sangui-nemque eo deducentia: calida nimi-rum admodum, non tamen substan-tiæ tenuis, sed nonnihil crassæ & sic-cæ; ut sabina, pulegium. Hisce simi-lia sunt, quæ lac & semē promovent. Deducunt enim sanguinem ad mam-mas, & testes. Non sunt tamen tam calida & sicca: hoc enim modo eru-ca semen excitat, & fœniculum vi-ride lac.
Generatio lactis, sicut & semi-nis, fit ex optimis alimentis, na-turæ opera. illorum tamen pro-vacatio & deductio ad convenien-tia membra, medicamentorum vi contingit sæpe.
Bechica & sputū moventia, duûm sunt generū, alia enim crassam & vis-cidam

page.notes: Facing left page is cut off at the scan edge; only fragmentary marginal words are visible and are not transcribed. The word "viscidam" at the end is set right-aligned and continues on the next page. Word "sputū" and "duûm" printed as shown; "semē" printed with macron.
